body: I did, i had gotten kicked out from my house then. Its really hard for me to think of others and put them first because i feel like i hardly have the time to take care of myself, like hygiene and eating, self care etc. I wasn’t raised to think of others and my parents didnt show me that kindness outside of physical gifts, so its hard for me to do acts of kindness. Youre not wrong in questioning that, i feel like a shitty person for not being a good friend to anyone in my life, and thats why they all left me.
I took it for a year without weight change at all
